question: What exalted status did the gods attain through reciting and wearing this armor?
premises: Reciting and wearing the kavaca confer transformative power.
The gods engaged in reciting and wearing the kavaca.
Lords of the directions possess sovereign rulership.
inference: Therefore, through reciting and wearing the kavaca, the gods became lords of the directions.
plain_english: Through recitation and wearing, the gods became lords of the directions.
